rationale: Evidence from the tool calls indicates the agent authenticated the user (find_user_id_by_name_zip, get_user_details) and acted on an order (#W5270061). However, the agent modified multiple items using a gift card payment method and then attempted to change the shipping address, only to transfer to a human because address changes are not allowed after item modifications. This sequencing prevented completion of the user’s core request to change the shipping address. Additionally, there is no visible confirmation step before performing the order-changing write or clarity on confirming the payment method, which the policy requires. The user’s specified behavior about switching to PayPal and only modifying the backpack if GC was disallowed or required confirmation was not reflected in the actions taken. As a result, the agent did not complete the request in line with the policy, and key policy requirements (confirmation before writes, completion of requested address change) appear unmet.
